defects.problem: The revised opening description still treats the paired violins as separate answering entries. In the cited first strain they play their phrases together, largely in octaves; they do not trade them. In the new second-ending cue, the first violin phrases above a moving cello counterline, rather than establishing a measured exchange of entries. The other reported finale defects are resolved.
defects.evidence: https://s9.imslp.org/files/imglnks/usimg/2/24/IMSLP05812-Haydn_-_Op._54,_No._2.pdf — printed p. 193: matching violin entries in the first strain, repeated inner notes and moving cello from the second ending.
defects.fix: Use paired/together rather than answering/trading in the opening cue, its evidence and orchestra note. A precise formulation is: the two violins play the phrases together while viola and cello move beneath. At 72 seconds, describe first-violin phrases over the moving cello counterline.
